sn48.46:1.2: Katinnaṃ nu kho bhikkhave indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulikatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññam vyākaroti ||
sn48.46:1.3: Khīnā jāti nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmī ti || ||
sn48.46:2.2: Dvinnaṃ kho bhikkhave indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti ||
sn48.46:2.5: Ariyāya ca paññāya ariyāya ca vimuttiyā || ||
sn48.46:2.6: Yā hissa bhikkhave ariyā paññā tad assa pāññindriyaṃ ||
sn48.46:2.7: yā hissa bhikkhave ariyā vimutti tad assa samādhindriyaṃ || || 5.
sn48.46:2.8: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave dvinnam indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti ||
